card.name: Fact sheet and factbook titles
card.fires_on: The word "Fact" or the following "Sheet" or "book" in titles like "Fact Sheet", "Factfinder" and "Factbook". Also fires on words in summary-style titles such as "Highlights of the Report".

modes.label: Fact in fact sheet
modes.description: The word Fact at the start of a fact sheet or factfinder title, often in a reference list or link.
modes.example: CDC web site: “Genital HPV Infection - CDC<< Fact>> Sheet.”

modes.label: Sheet or book after fact
modes.description: The word Sheet or book completing fact sheet or factbook.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like facts, summary and synopsis, which fit overview documents.
card.plain: It lights up on the words "fact sheet" or "factbook" when they name a short summary document.
